class.name: lekiwi_isaac_hardware/LekIwiIsaacSystem
class.description: Bridges the LeKiwi ros2_control controller_manager to NVIDIA Isaac Sim 5.1. State is read from sensor_msgs/JointState published by the isaacsim.ros2.bridge ROS2PublishJointState OmniGraph node, and velocity (wheels) / position (arm) commands are published as sensor_msgs/JointState for the isaacsim.ros2.bridge ROS2SubscribeJointState node, which feeds the isaacsim.core.nodes.IsaacArticulationController driving /World/LeKiwi.
